summary: Profile avatar upload and product export
description: Shoppers upload a PNG avatar on their profile, by choosing the file or dropping it on the drop zone. Shop staff export the product list as a CSV file.
acceptanceCriteria: A PNG avatar up to 2 MB is accepted; the page shows its file name and size in bytes.
A file larger than 2 MB is refused with the message File too large.
Export CSV on the products page downloads products.csv with a header and one row per product.
